eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study uses an LSTM model for tacrolimus level prediction in adult lung transplant recipients, but it does not assess survival, waitlist mortality, post‑transplant complications, quality of life, or economic outcomes required for inclusion.

identification_methods.Setting: Single-center retrospective study at Okayama University Hospital
identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective observational study of lung transplant recipients using time‑series tacrolimus dosing data.
identification_methods.Institution: Okayama University Graduate School of Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmaceutical Sciences
identification_methods.Dataset Source: Electronic medical records from Okayama University Hospital (117 patients, 87,112 data points)
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Retrospective observational study of adult lung transplant patients; excluded infants <10 kg and cases with short tacrolimus administration or outlier TTLs.
identification_methods.AI Model Architecture: Multivariate Long Short‑Term Memory (LSTM) network with a 3‑layer structure
identification_methods.Input Variables: 36 clinical factors including tacrolimus dose, route, prior TTLs, demographics, laboratory values, intra‑ and postoperative variables.
identification_methods.Missing Data Handling: Mean imputation for missing time‑point values with flag indicators; Z‑score normalization applied.
identification_methods.Validation Method: Random split of cohort into training (80 %), validation (10 %) and test (10 %); external simulation cohort of 6 cases used for additional validation.
identification_methods.Methods Notes: SHAP used for feature selection; model optimized by minimizing mean squared error; performance reported with R² and percentage of predictions within ±30 % of actual TTL.

population.Exclusion criteria: Infants <10 kg, short tacrolimus administration (<5 days), TTL outliers
population.Population Notes: Single-center retrospective study at Okayama University Hospital, data from April 2011 to May 2023; 117 patients used for model development and 6 cases for validation

interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: Time series of tacrolimus dose, administration route, and prior trough levels
interventions_outcomes.Feature Selection Method: Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) used to identify important features
interventions_outcomes.Temporal Handling: Multistep time series forecasting using the previous three time points
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Multivariate LSTM model trained on 117 patients (87,112 data points) with 80/10/10 train‑validation‑test split; validated on 6 additional cases
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Prediction accuracy of tacrolimus trough levels (TTL)
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Accuracy reported as proportion within ±30% of actual TTL and R² value
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: Model achieved 88.5% of predictions within ±30% error and R² = 0.67 on test dataset
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reported name: Proportion of TTL predictions within ±30% of actual values
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reported as: Percentage within error margin and R²
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome group: All lung transplant recipients in the test set
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: Proportion of predicted TTLs that fall within 30% of the measured TTL
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: High accuracy achieved with minimal input variables; performance stable across administration routes
